title: Chapter 321: Interstellar Protoss
content:
Chapter 321: Interstellar Protoss

Looking at the energy ball of the world rules in front of him, Wu Qing had nothing to consider and directly chose to use the special status and authority of the clan.

Even if there are any problems with the aggregation of the world rules, there is no need to worry. The system is waiting to use the legitimate authority of this world to exploit the loopholes of the universe world.

The special status and authority of the clan automatically binds the Zerg who use the special quota of the clan status.

Wu Qing immediately learned from the information feedback from the world rules that the Zerg has obtained many privileges in this world.

These privileges are almost all privileges related to the development of races and territories, and they are of great significance to the native races of this world.

The degree of suppression of the world rules on the members of the Zerg has been greatly reduced, and the difficulty of obtaining luck has been greatly reduced.

The population fertility rate and population quality of the Zerg's forces have been greatly improved, the territory has been prosperous, and the output of various resources has increased greatly.

In this way, all aspects of the development of races and territories will be blessed to a certain extent by the world rules.

As long as the races of the native world obtain these world rule privileges, it will not take much time to develop rapidly.

Wu Qing glanced at the description of the further weakening of the suppression of strength by the world rules and stopped paying attention to the numerous privileges. The privileges granted by the world rules are of some help to the development of the Zerg, but this is not the focus of Wu Qing's attention.

Wu Qing cares about whether the system has taken advantage of this opportunity to gain benefits.

Wu Qing rarely felt nervous: "Can the subsidiary world take advantage of this opportunity to be born? Or can the system provide more auxiliary functions? Or let other interstellar races be born?"

The system has not made any movement for the time being, but based on Wu Qing's understanding of the system, the Zerg has achieved a milestone achievement, and the system will definitely do something.

Wu Qing waited patiently.

"Ding!"

A familiar system prompt sounded, and Wu Qing's heart trembled.

Since Wu Qing came to this world, the system has given a simple prompt message, and the system has never appeared since then.

The system has a prompt sound, indicating that the system, as Wu Qing guessed, has taken advantage of the authority given to the Zerg by the world rules this time, and has gained some benefits from the suppression of the will of the universe.

"Please select the interstellar race base, human race/protoss."

The system prompt is very simple, without any extra words. It seems that under the suppression of the will of the universe in this world, it is very difficult for the system to display one more word.

Seeing this system prompt, Wu Qing was happy, but also a little regretful. The people he once knew could not meet for the time being. If he wanted to meet again, he needed to continue to work hard in this world.

Wu Qing put aside unnecessary emotions and considered the choice of the other two interstellar races.

The interstellar human base already exists in the system's subsidiary system, but it has been unable to develop due to the restrictions of the world. He does not know to what extent it has developed now.

If the interstellar human base is materialized in this world, with the powerful technological power of the interstellar human race, it will be difficult to meet an opponent on the battlefield of this world.

However, in this world, Wu Qing has the Zerg under his command, and the problem on the battlefield is not big. It is better to have the interstellar human race. If there is no interstellar human race for the time being, it will not have much impact.

The interstellar Protoss, who have strong individual combat power and equally strong technological power, can effectively make up for the shortcomings of the Zerg by uniting with the Zerg in this world, which is a better choice.

The weirdness of this world is mysterious and unpredictable. Wu Qing saw various mutant weirds rampant in the peaceful areas without the influence of the camp war through the Tiancan Knight who had entered the hinterland of the native race.

The mutant weirds entered the territory and city of the native race in various ways. The protection of the world rule-level lords was invalid for them. Each mutant weird could set off a huge storm in a region.

The reasons for these weird mutations are strange and there is no pattern to find. They are hard to prevent. There are special departments in various places to deal with mutant weird events to deal with weird events.

Wu Qing learned a lot of weird information through the battle between the Zerg extermination troops and the weird. With the hints of the goblins and the Naga, the Zerg is likely to face the weird problem after gaining the status of a big clan.

The game setting of the star Protoss is that each soldier is very precious and powerful. The energy field formed by the equipment manufactured by the Protoss through powerful spiritual power and advanced technology is extremely powerful. Before the energy field is destroyed, the body of the Protoss cannot be harmed.

They also have powerful soldiers that combine spiritual power and technology, and various unmanned combat weapon soldiers.

The Protoss has a strong spiritual power talent and strong technological strength. According to the setting of this game, the interstellar Protoss that is materialized in this world after the system optimization is very exciting.

"Choose the interstellar Protoss!"

Wu Qing made a choice. This decision was not made at this moment, but he has been thinking about this issue all along.

The interstellar Protoss is a better choice. Now I just hope that the system can optimize the interstellar Protoss to be more suitable for this world.

After Wu Qing made the choice, the system did not continue to give prompts. It sent an option to materialize the interstellar Protoss base, and then there was no movement.

Wu Qing did not care, nor did he materialize the Protoss base immediately. Instead, he entered the base under the Zerg base camp and came to the new space that had just been opened up to the west of the underground base.

This space, which had not been built for Zerg construction for a short time, was already covered with Zerg fungal blankets for more than half.

Wu Qing thought about it and chose to materialize the interstellar Protoss base, which was located in the area covered by the Zerg fungus blanket.

A huge building with a mysterious glow appeared out of thin air. This mysterious building with a golden base color is the main control base of the interstellar Protoss.

The Protoss base was successfully built on the Zerg fungus blanket, which means that the system no longer distinguishes between Zerg and Protoss according to the game settings. Whether it is Zerg, Protoss, or the Terrans that will appear in the future, they all belong to Wu Qing and there is no need to distinguish between them.

Wu Qing approached the Protoss main control base, which is a mysterious technological building with a peculiar future sci-fi style.

The Protoss base comes with five unmanned detectors, which are equivalent to Zerg worker bees, and can build Protoss buildings and mine resources.

In the game settings, all Protoss buildings and arms are transmitted through portals, rather than hatching like Zerg and cloning like Terrans.

The Protoss in this world were created by the system. There were no real Protoss that could be teleported here, so the Protoss's building system was built out of thin air. The Protoss's personnel were also materialized by the system, just like in Age of Empires and Red Alert.

Wu Qing chose a Protoss unmanned probe and found that all Protoss buildings could be built, including the highest-level Zhongzai Temple of the Protoss, and the required resources were system resources, shared with the Zerg.

Wu Qing understood that this was the system's release of all restrictions on the interstellar Protoss. The Protoss did not need to walk the road that the Zerg had walked once again.

The interstellar Protoss appeared in this world, and it was the strongest state!

This made Wu Qing feel very good. He was afraid that the system would impose some more powerful restrictions, so that the Protoss would not be able to play a big role in a short time.

Moreover, Wu Qing also found that because of the intervention of the system, the rules of this world regarded the Protoss as the same race as the Zerg, enjoying the world rule authority of the Zerg's status as a major clan.

The bases built by the Protoss and the territories occupied by the Protoss would be regarded as part of the Zerg territory.

The system seems to have directly integrated the Protoss and the Zerg in many aspects to facilitate Wu Qing's management and command.

After the Zerg gained the status of a major clan, the system gained a lot of resources, and now the system resources are very sufficient.

Wu Qing commanded five Protoss unmanned probes to build the Protoss buildings one by one.

The Protoss unmanned probes only need to create a logo to build a building, which is very fast.

It does not need to consume itself like the Zerg worker bees, nor does it need to build step by step like the human race, but it is automatically generated without interference.

In the game setting, this is the process of transmission, and in this world, it is the process of materialization out of thin air.

The Protoss buildings such as the military station, furnace, control core, photon turret, mechanical factory, air force station, speed tower, mechanical support body, cluster tower, temple, watchtower, Zhongzai Temple, etc. are presented in front of Wu Qing one by one.

These Protoss buildings with the same style and different functions are reasonably distributed in the huge underground space, and they support the entire Protoss technology system.

Wu Qing discovered that the crystal, the core building of the Protoss, did not need to be built. He understood it as soon as he thought about it. The crystal, protective battery and other buildings related to energy transmission were all optimized by the system.

Like the Zerg, the Protoss used the unified energy transmission system of the system and also existed based on the system. The Protoss did not need to come up with a unique energy transmission system.

The Protoss in this world used the energy transmission system of the system and would no longer be restricted by crystals. No matter where they were, they would have the support of system energy, and the strength of the Protoss would become stronger.

After the Protoss buildings were built, all the Protoss arms could be materialized in this world.

Wu Qing materialized one of each of the Protoss arms, including Berserker, Dragon Knight, High Templar, Dark Templar, Transporter, Gold Beetle, Detector, Reconnaissance Aircraft, Corsair, Mothership, and Intermediate Carrier.

The initial star rating of these Protoss arms was seven stars, because they were too weak to withstand their powerful strength.

Moreover, the resources consumed by materializing the Protoss arms were equivalent to the ultimate arms of the Zerg, which was very expensive.

"Master!"

"Master!"

"..."

All the Protoss warriors called Wu Qing the Master.

The system even unified the Protoss's name for Wu Qing with the Zerg.

Facing the Protoss warriors, Wu Qing naturally understood that the system only picked up the useful points of the messy things about the Protoss in the background information of the StarCraft game, and discarded the rest.

The Protoss after the system optimization is just a pure race that inherits the power and technology, religious beliefs, and racial characteristics of the Protoss.

There is no division, no faction, no complicated relationship within the Protoss, only the master Wu Qing who has the only faith.

After obtaining this information, Wu Qing's hanging heart was finally put down. He has always been a little worried that the Protoss, a powerful creature with independent wisdom, mysterious and unique, would be difficult to control.

The system was very considerate to solve this problem for him and did not let him down.

Wu Qing spent some time studying the various arms of the Protoss. He found that except for the three arms of the Berserker, High Templar and Dark Templar, which are the real Protoss, all other arms are powerful unmanned combat weapons.

All unmanned combat weapons, in addition to automatic combat, can be controlled by the Protoss to exert even more powerful combat power.

This chapter is not yet finished, please click on the next page to continue reading the exciting content below!

The interstellar Protoss are similar in size to humans, and are about two meters tall.

They will be equipped with different equipment according to different arms, and use their own strong spiritual power talents, combined with powerful exclusive equipment, to exert extremely powerful combat power.

Every individual of the Protoss is a very talented warrior. They only have different development directions, thus becoming different arms. There is no difference between the strengths and weaknesses of the Protoss arms.

In the game setting, the light archon and dark archon formed by the fusion of two high-level templars and two dark templars are changed to the upgrade direction of the high-level templars and the dark archon for the dark templars in this world.

If the high-level templars and dark templars with strong talents are willing, they can choose to transfer to the light archon and the dark archon. After the transfer is successful, they can become powerful light archons and dark archons in the form of spirit and energy.

Wu Qing upgraded all the upgrade options of all Protoss buildings, and the abilities of each arm of the Protoss were displayed in front of him.

Wu Qing read it carefully. Just by looking at the description, he could feel the difference between the Protoss and the Zerg. Each of the Protoss's arms was very powerful.

How the Protoss' arms performed in this world still needed to be tested in actual combat on the battlefield.

The Protoss had a large number of unmanned combat weapons, and their control center was the Protoss' main control base.

The Zerg had a queen, and the Protoss had a main control base. The main control base also had a powerful intelligent brain "Archon" to assist Wu Qing in managing the Protoss.

The Protoss' communication network was automatically connected to the Zerg network, and they could communicate with each other, which was similar to the sharing of the system's energy transmission channel.

With the support of the intelligent brain "Archon", the communication network and the energy transmission network, each Protoss individual had a strong spiritual power and exclusive powerful equipment connected to the three. Wu Qing could easily command the entire Protoss like commanding the Zerg.

The Zerg obtained the status of a large clan, and the interstellar Protoss was born. The power in Wu Qing's hands was unprecedentedly strengthened.

With such power in his hands, Wu Qing could face any difficulties calmly.

The interstellar Protoss will bring many surprises to this world.
